# Vishrea Studio

> Independent luxury womenswear studio & atelier based in Bengaluru, India. Creator of one-of-one silhouettes, curated designer pieces, and the Walkin Wardrobe styling membership.

Vishrea Studio specializes in limited-run, one-of-one womenswear silhouettes, bespoke fashion tailoring, and private wardrobe curation. Headquartered in Electronic City Phase 2, Bengaluru, the studio operates both a physical walk-in atelier and a nationwide direct-to-consumer digital storefront.

## Atelier & Location (GEO Grounding)
- **Studio Name**: Vishrea Studio
- **Address**: 16, 4th Cross, Kammasandra Rd, Hebbagodi, Electronic City Phase 2, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560100, India
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 12.8368° N, Longitude 77.6833° E
- **Google Knowledge Graph**: https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=%2Fg%2F11mlpxsxf5
- **Hours**: Monday to Sunday, 10:30 AM – 8:30 PM IST
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 6364116567
- **Google Review Rating**: 5.0 ★ (47 verified reviews)

## Core Offerings & Specializations
- **One-of-One Silhouettes**: Limited-edition statement pieces where each silhouette is curated or crafted with unique cuts, fabrics, and drape.
- **Walkin Wardrobe Membership**: Curated private shopping tier with exclusive monthly wardrobe drops, early access, styling consultations, and store credits.
- **Skin Tone & Colour Analysis**: Interactive palette recommendations (Cool, Warm, Neutral, Olive) paired with curated apparel pairings.
- **Custom Alterations & Fit**: Bespoke sizing adjustments available upon request for orders and in-studio consultations.
